routing_findings.finding: MediaDB253-256-derived HMM recipes are named for Junlon PW110 but ingredients/1 is Propenoate with KEGG:acryl and monomer-derived millimolar values. Hobbs primary abstract identifies Junlon as polymer; source product identity must not become acrylate. Precise polymer lot chemistry and dose normalization remain unapproved.
